card.name: US place names in regional contexts
card.fires_on: Words naming or following US states and regions (Utah, Arkansas, Texas, California, 50 states, Metropolitan Statistical Area) in general web text about geography or government.

modes.label: State names
modes.description: The state name itself, often after a preposition like into or in.
modes.example: bring the following animal parts into<< Utah>>: Meat that is cut and wrapped

modes.label: Region and institution terms
modes.description: Words in US place-based titles such as Metropolitan or Conference after a place name.
modes.example: center of the Richmond<< Metropolitan>> Statistical Area and the Greater Richmond area

modes.label: Partway through state names
modes.description: Inside a longer place name or the number of states.

card.writes: It seems to push toward place-name and region continuations, while suppressing Chinese words for county, district and city.
card.plain: It lights up on US state and region names and the words that follow them in geographic phrases.
